main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Premier North Queensland venue featuring a 1,680m oval and a short 310m home straight. The tight geometry and brief final stretch generate a natural bias toward front-runners ('E') and pocket pressers ('P') holding the fence. Deep closers ('Swoopers') frequently run out of stretch length on Good ground.
main_turf.post_bias: INSIDE BARRIER BIAS: Inside barriers (stalls 1–4) in 1000m, 1200m, and 1400m races hold a distinct advantage to secure early rail position into the turn. Wide draws (9+) face significant ground-loss penalties.

handicapping_angles.cluden_short_straight_speed_bias: Aggressively upgrade lone early speed ('E') and rail-skimming tactical stalkers ('P'). Downgrade deep closers ('Swoopers') settling in the back half of the field unless a frantic pace duel is projected.
handicapping_angles.brisbane_and_rockhampton_shippers: Townsville regularly attracts high-volume shippers from Brisbane (Tony Gollan, Chris Waller) and Rockhampton/Mackay (Ricky Vale, Nick Walsh, Stephen Rundle). Upgrade Brisbane Metro and Provincial shippers dropping into NQ ranks (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.townsville_cup_and_cleveland_bay_carniva: During the Winter Carnival featuring the $150k Townsville Cup (2000m) and $100k Cleveland Bay Handicap (1300m - 'Newmarket of the North'), race class elevates to Metro/Listed grade. Factor in higher speed par offsets for feature races.
handicapping_angles.tropical_wet_track_mudlarks: During North Queensland monsoon downpours, the track shifts rapidly to Soft/Heavy. Heavily upgrade proven wet-trackers ('Mudlarks') with 2+ wins on rain-affected ground.
handicapping_angles.cairns_and_mackay_circuit_form: The NQ circuit flows Townsville → Cairns → Mackay. Horses in-form at Cairns (Cannon Park) or Mackay dropping into the Townsville feature program carry strong circuit form. Upgrade Cairns/Mackay provincial winners stepping into Townsville BM65-BM70 company (+2.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Standard program: 1000m, 1200m, 1400m, 1600m, 1800m, 2000m. Winter Carnival extends to the 2000m Townsville Cup distance.
